city.title: City
city.description: A city, e.g. San Francisco, New York, Los Angeles.

vibe.title: Vibe or ask
vibe.description: What you're looking for, in plain words: "cozy bookstore", "lit pickleball courts", "hot pot", "a quiet view".

subreddit.title: Subreddit (optional)
subreddit.description: Where locals talk. Defaults to the city's ask-locals subreddit (AskSF, AskNYC, ...).

redditThreads.title: Reddit threads to read
redditThreads.description: How many top threads (and their comments) to read for mentions.

useApifyProxy.title: Use Apify Proxy for Reddit
useApifyProxy.description: Reddit often blocks data-center IPs. Turn on to route Reddit requests through Apify Proxy.

redditScraper.title: Fall back to Apify's Reddit scraper
redditScraper.description: When Reddit blocks direct reads, read the same threads with harshmaur/reddit-scraper (billed to your account, capped by the budget below).

redditBudgetUsd.title: Reddit scraper budget (USD)
redditBudgetUsd.description: The most one run of the Reddit scraper may cost.
